xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3174 CodeQL polynomial-redos in xbrief/styles.ts

narratives.Description: Four open CodeQL js/polynomial-redos warnings in packages/core/src/xbrief/styles.ts (security code-scanning alerts #84-#87) flag regexes that can run slowly on pathological spaced input. Clear the findings with safe parsers or bounded regexes while keeping style/heading parse behavior.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit packages/core/src/xbrief/styles.ts around the flagged id:/style:/heading regexes (CodeQL L239-L251 region) to use linear-time parsing or non-polynomial patterns.
2. Extend packages/core/src/xbrief tests (or styles-adjacent tests) for normal and adversarial long-space inputs; verify npm test for xbrief styles still passes.
3. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Security/Fixed for #3174; confirm alerts auto-close after merge.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want CodeQL polynomial-redos alerts on xBRIEF styles cleared, so that security-and-quality stays green without ReDoS risk on untrusted style text.
narratives.Overview: Code scanning alerts 84-87; warning severity; single-file cluster.

narrative.Acceptance: Given CodeQL alerts #84-#87 on packages/core/src/xbrief/styles.ts, when the fix lands on master, then those js/polynomial-redos alerts close or are no longer raised on the fixed lines.
Given existing xBRIEF style/heading parsing tests and adversarial long-space inputs, when tests run, then legitimate inputs still parse correctly and pathological inputs do not hang.
